## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it belongs in Sura's current scope.

## Verification

List the exact commands and results you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] New success and failure behavior has automated coverage.
- [ ] Examples use real Sura syntax (`is`, `func ... do ... end`).
- [ ] Public syntax/API/CLI changes update guides and generated reference data.
- [ ] Compatibility and support-tier impact is recorded.
- [ ] Applicable Windows and cross-platform CI paths include the new test.
- [ ] Performance claims include reproducible raw evidence.
